description: Log in to ArkCase (admin/ArkCase1234!) and locate the new complaint case titled 'Procurement Irregularities - Q3 2024'. This case has just been submitted and is currently in the 'New' state. Your goal is to triage this case by advancing its workflow status. Open the case, locate the workflow/action menu (often a 'State' button, 'Actions' menu, or gear icon), and execute the transition to move it to an 'Active' or 'Triaged' state (e.g., click 'Start', 'Accept', or 'Submit'). Verify the status indicator changes from 'New'.
